title: Queueing System UI Optimization

structured_notes.concern: The queueing kiosk UI experienced heavy flashing and lag because the entire page re-rendered when a new number was added.
structured_notes.action_taken: The TEACHER analyzed the React state management and found the state was placed too high in the component tree without proper isolation.
structured_notes.outcome: The STUDENT was instructed to isolate state changes to smaller, specific components and ensure unique `key` props were used for list items.
structured_notes.remarks: UI optimization is vital for public-facing office kiosks. Refactoring the components will solve the visual glitch and improve performance.

reference_transcript:
Teacher: Let's talk about the automated queueing system you are building for the kiosk. How is the interface performing?
Student: The core logic works, but when the line gets long, the screen flashes every time a new number is added. It is very distracting for the users in the office.
Teacher: The flashing means the whole React component is re-rendering completely instead of just updating the new item. Are you storing the queue list in a main state that triggers a full page refresh?
Student: Yes, I put the state at the very top of my component tree so the header and the footer can also access the current queue count.
Teacher: That explains it. Every time the queue state changes, React redraws the header, the footer, and the entire list. You need to isolate the state.
Student: How do I isolate it if multiple parts of the screen need the data?
Teacher: You can use a state management tool, or simply pass the total count as a separate prop, while keeping the main list state localized to the specific component that displays the numbers.
Student: Oh, so I break the layout into smaller components, and only the list component re-renders when a new number arrives.
Teacher: Correct. Also, make sure you are using unique `key` props for each item in the list so React knows exactly which element to add without redrawing the others.
Student: I will break down the layout and check my keys. That should stop the full screen from flashing.
reference_summary: The STUDENT noticed bad visual flashing in the kiosk interface of a queueing system. The TEACHER pointed out that improper state management in React was causing full-page re-renders. The STUDENT will restructure the components to ensure only the necessary parts of the screen update.
